comments.author: @AnyaNiklaus
comments.text: They are very childlike in their thinking.  But it may have come about for survival like they said.  If you sleep too long there are dangers in the jungle.

comments.author: @AnyaNiklaus
comments.text: I don't understand why people are baffled about their language or the way they think.  Does no one remember how we thought when we were children?  Because basically what they described was the way children think.  Children don't care about numbers.  They don't think of colors.  They don't care about the past or the future. The only care about the Here and Now.  They definitely wouldn't believe stories about the outside world.  They'd have to see it for themselves.  Most of us still largely do.  Think about the atheists.  They don't believe anything they can't see with their own eyes. All That stuff that we do differently, has to be practically beaten into us.  Not quite literally but close enough.  We are constantly being pushed to think about the future and not the Here and Now.  Because children live in the Here and Now.  We go to school to learn numbers and colors and all that stuff.  I mean it makes perfect sense to describe something that looks like something in order for someone else to understand.  We do that even as adults for things that we don't have words for.  It's just a very simple uncomplicated way of thinking. When I was a child I always used to think that adults complicate things way too much.  I don't think that that's a bad thing.  And I don't think that the way they live is a bad thing.  It's just different.  They live like children.  We think not being like a child is the most important thing to be.  Neither way is right or wrong.  However I don't think I'd like living in a tribe where I wasn't allowed to sleep.  And I'm very glad that I know about God.
